name: Number scale
summary: A row of tappable whole numbers on the audience phone — a Net Promoter Score 0–10 by default, or any short numeric rating — with the end labels under it.
highlights: NPS 0–10 or any short numeric rating
48px tappable numbers, six per row on a phone
Radio group with arrow keys, mirrored in RTL
Locks and restores the score after an iframe remount
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-number-scale> — for a score the participant taps rather than drags (<aha-scale-slider> is the dragged scale). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Number
spec.value: height 48, radius 8, 1px ink hairline at 12% on the frosted surface; 16px / 24px, 600, deck ink

spec.label: Layout
spec.value: one equal row while every number fits at its 44px minimum; below that (an 11-point scale under 524px) six per row

spec.label: Pick
spec.value: filled with the deck accent, number in the accent ink; the keyboard focus ring is a 2px outline in the deck ink, offset 2px

spec.label: End labels
spec.value: 14px / 20px, deck ink at 76%, under the numbers, low at the start and high at the end; also read out with the end numbers

spec.label: Locked
spec.value: disabled or a locked lock-key: the other numbers mute to 55%, the pick stays at full strength

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: value
props.desc: The picked number; also the `value` property (null before a pick)

props.name: low-label / high-label
props.desc: The end labels under the scale ("Not at all likely" / "Extremely likely"); pass translated text

props.name: group-label
props.desc: The radio group's accessible name: pass the translated question

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Mutes the other numbers and ignores picks

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: change
props.desc: Fires on every pick with the number

whenToUse.when: a score of up to about 11 whole numbers the participant taps: NPS 0–10, a 1–5 or 1–10 rating shown as numbers
a wide or continuous range the participant drags
stars or faces (a rating), or a free number (an input)

opinion.note: Replaces a hand-built row of number buttons, which re-opens the radio keyboard contract, the deck ink, the frosted surface and the submission lock. NPS bands (detractor, passive, promoter) are not coloured: that is a colour-rules decision. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
